name: Code coverage
description: The coverage the build already measured, read from whichever report format it left behind and normalized into one shape: the line and branch totals across every report, and a summary per file. The covered and missed line numbers are left out unless you set `lineDetail`, because a large repository's line map is bigger than the facts document is allowed to be. Reports that name the same file are merged line by line, so a per module report and a merged report agree, but a report carrying only totals is added on top.

reports.description: Comma separated globs matched against every file in the working directory and against bare file names, naming the coverage reports to read.

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to carry in `byFile`, those with the most uncovered lines first. The totals still include files that are dropped.

lineDetail.description: `true` to carry the covered and missed line numbers of every file in `byFile`. A guardrail that checks the lines a change touched needs them; for everything else they only add size.

facts.source: `report` when a coverage report was read, `none` when there was none.
facts.reason: Why nothing was read, present only when `source` is `none`.
facts.reports: Every report that was read, in path order.
facts.reports[].path: Path of the report, relative to the directory the CLI runs in.
facts.reports[].modified: When the report was last written, in ISO 8601, so you can spot a stale report.
facts.reports[].format: Format it was read as: `jacoco`, `cobertura`, `istanbul` or `lcov`.
facts.lines.covered: Lines at least one report saw executed, counted once across every report that names the file.
facts.lines.percent: Covered lines as a percentage of the lines the reports measured, to two decimal places, `0.0` when they measured none.
facts.branches: The branch totals, or `null` when no report that was read carries branch coverage.
facts.branches.percent: Taken branches as a percentage of the branches the reports measured, to two decimal places.
facts.files: How many files the reports measured, before `maxFiles` was applied.
facts.byFile: A summary per file, the ones with the most uncovered lines first, up to `maxFiles`.
facts.byFile[path].covered: Lines of that file at least one report saw executed.
facts.byFile[path].missed: Lines of that file every report saw unexecuted.
facts.byFile[path].percent: Covered lines of that file as a percentage, to two decimal places.
facts.byFile[path].coveredLines: The covered line numbers, ascending, present only when `lineDetail` is `true`.
facts.byFile[path].missedLines: The missed line numbers, ascending, present only when `lineDetail` is `true`.
facts.dropped: Files left out of `byFile` because `maxFiles` was reached.
